items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: Always call him Nose, that's all I remember his name.

ctx.x: Who did you play with? Who were you playing with?

And there I was, I was waiting with Charlie Love, Joe Robichill, drummer for Marl. I'm Shreveport, I forget his name. I don't know what I call him. Always call him Nose, that's all I remember his name. Can't think his name. And, Kim will wake with us a while, he was just starting up. Well, uh, now he came with him. Yeah. I think he was going to school at the time. I wish I was.
Who were, now what about trombone plays? What styles did you, did there any, were there any particular people you, uh, you thought were particularly good or anything?
